name: Tripuram Shantam
text:
Tripuram Tripuram Shantam,
Tripureswaram Mahakritam,
Maha Devyam Sarva Shakthim,
Sarva Dharmadharinim. Sarva Jeevanam Tam Hleem,
Sarva Kasta Nivarinim Swaha
note: From Sarvakali’s guru, kept exactly as given. It joins Tripura Sundari and Shakti.
source: Sarvakali’s teaching (her guru’s version); not a published text
pronunciation: tri-pu-ram tri-pu-ram shaan-tam; tri-pu-resh-va-ram ma-haa-kri-tam; ma-haa day-vyam sar-va shak-tim; sar-va dhar-ma-dhaa-ri-neem, sar-va jee-va-nam tam hleem; sar-va kash-ta ni-vaa-ri-neem svaa-haa
